Selection_Method: 4-fold GroupKFold by Sample_No; AutoGluon trained with RMSE; models secondarily re-ranked by normalized composite score
Composite_Formula: 0.35*RPD + 0.25*RPIQ + 0.20*RMSE + 0.15*R2 + 0.05*MAE (all components min-max normalized across grouped-CV candidate models; RMSE and MAE inverted)
